# @vllnt/convex-experiments

> Deterministic A/B testing for Convex: sticky weighted variant assignment, deduped exposure tracking and per-variant tallies, as a Convex component.

Install `@vllnt/convex-experiments` (unreleased builds from `main` use the `canary`
dist-tag). Peer dependency `convex@^1.45.0`; optional peer `react >=18` for the
`./react` hooks; Node.js `>=18`. Mount it with `app.use(experiments)` from
`@vllnt/convex-experiments/convex.config` and call it through
`new Experiments(components.experiments)` from host mutations and queries.
Mutations: `define`, `setStatus`, `assign`, `logExposure`, `forgetSubject`,
`deleteExperiment`. Queries: `getExperiment`, `listExperiments`,
`getAssignment`, `peek`, `results`. Lifecycle: `draft` -> `running` ->
`stopped`; only `running` enrolls, and `assign`/`logExposure`/`peek` return
`{ variant: null }` otherwise (also for an absent experiment). A variant is a
32-bit FNV-1a hash over the UTF-16 code units of `${scope}:${salt}:${subjectRef}`
on the ordered cumulative-weight line; `salt` defaults to the key. `variants`
and `salt` are immutable once a subject is assigned (`EXPERIMENT_LOCKED`); define
a new key to re-randomize. Re-running `define` without `status` resets the status
to the client `defaultStatus` (restarting a stopped experiment). Queries do not
reject empty identifiers (`peek` with `subjectRef: ""` returns a variant). Every
`logExposure` adds 1 to `exposures` (no idempotency key); `subjects` counts each
subject once. `results` reads maintained per-variant tallies (`assigned`,
`subjects`, `exposures`, `weight`) in O(variants). Client defaults:
`defaultScope: "global"`, `defaultStatus: "running"`. Delete batches default to
200 and must be integers 1..500 (`INVALID_BATCH`). Invalid input throws
`ConvexError` with `data.code` `INVALID_ARGUMENT`, `INVALID_VARIANTS` (with a
`reason`), `INVALID_BATCH` or `EXPERIMENT_LOCKED`. The host owns auth, the
outcome metric (in its own tables, joined on the variant), significance tests
and release control; scopes are not authorization.

## When to use

- Use it when every subject must get one weighted variant of an experiment, the
  same one on every later call.
- Use it when you need per-variant counts of assigned subjects, exposed subjects
  and exposures, or a variant before anything is written (`peek`).
- Do not use it for release control, rollouts or kill-switches: use a
  feature-flag system.
- Do not use it to store outcomes or compute significance: use your own tables
  or an analytics store, and a statistics tool.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the npm package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-experiments/docs/`
and match the installed version. Read them, and the bundled `src/`, before writing code.
The links below to `./` paths are files inside the installed package.

## Source (bundled)

- [Client](./src/client/index.ts): The `Experiments` class

- [React hooks](./src/react/index.tsx): `useVariant`, `useAssignment`, `useExperimentResults`
